release_notes: Major Release v2.0.0 (Build 60) — Rust Core Engine + Pure AppKit 60 FPS Edition: Replaced SwiftUI completely with a Rust staticlib core engine (real-time 4096-pt FFT DSP, MultitouchSupport/IOKit beat haptics, LRC/eLRC/TTML/Plain parsers, monotonic playback clock, color extractor, and streaming OTA updater) paired with a zero-SwiftUI AppKit/CALayer shell. Delivers locked 60 FPS VSync on both Apple Silicon and Intel MacBook 12" 2017 with ~15-25 MB RAM and 0% CPU when paused or idle.
